checks.name: cli_discovery
checks.stdout:
Usage: python -m twinstudio.cli [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...                    
                                                                                
 TwinStudio CLI. Uses the same typed command/query contracts as REST, MQTT and  
 MCP. The legacy executable name 'lps' remains a compatibility alias in version 
 0.5.0.                                                                         
                                                                                
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --install-completion          Install completion for the current shell.      │
│ --show-completion             Show completion for the current shell, to copy │
│                               it or customize the installation.              │
│ --help                        Show this message and exit.                    │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ serve           Run the REST, web and MCP application.                       │
│ seed            Create or recreate the example project in the configured     │
│                 event store.                                                 │
│ projects        List projects available in the configured event store.       │
│ tree            Print the hierarchical product object tree.                  │
│ command         Execute one typed CQRS command.                              │
│ plan            Compile a scoped natural-language change request into a      │
│                 typed ChangePlan.                                            │
│ lenses          Print the source-grounded Feature Type Spectrum catalog.     │
│ fixation        Run a design-fixation review and optionally record it.       │
│ dsl-schema      Print or write the canonical EvolutionProgram JSON Schema.   │
│ dsl-grammar     Print the EBNF grammar for TwinScript 1.0.                   │
│ dsl-parse       Parse TwinScript/YAML/JSON and emit canonical validated      │
│                 JSON.                                                        │
│ dsl-preview     Compile a DSL program into an evolution run without writing  │
│                 project events.                                              │
│ dsl-apply       Preview or record a validated DSL program through the CQRS   │
│                 event stream.                                                │
│ evolution-runs  List recorded evolution runs.                                │
│ evolution-show  Show one recorded evolution run or a graph representation.   │
│ lifecycles      Show lifecycle blueprints and transition history.            │
│ power           Run the reduced-order power and voltage-drop model.          │
│ export          Export a portable .twinstudio.zip project bundle.            │
│ gtin-complete   Calculate a GTIN check digit; this does not allocate a GS1   │
│                 identifier.                                                  │
│ gtin-validate   Exit with status 0 only when the GTIN check digit is valid.  │
│ shell           Start a small interactive shell around the same service      │
│                 layer.                                                       │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
